result.topic_en: Conditions for the solvability of the ternary quadratic equation ax²+by²+cz²=0 in terms of quadratic residues, followed by a rule for imaginary powers (exponentials with imaginary exponents) of complex numbers.
result.transcription:
Zur Möglichkeit des Ausdrucks
$a\Box + b = c\Box$
1) daß $+bc$ ein R. v. $a$ sei
2) daß $-ab$ ein Rest v. $c$ sei
3) daß $+ac$ ein R. v. $b$ sei

wird erfordert: Generalissime
ad possibilitatem
aequationis
$axx + byy + czz = 0$
requiritur
I) Vt non omnes $a, b, c$
idem signum habeant

Allgemeiner zur Möglichkeit der Gleichung
$a\Box + b\Box = c\Box$ ist nöthig daß
1) $+ac$ R. v. $b$
2) $-ab$ R. v. $c$
3) $+bc$ R. v. $a$ } sei

II) vt $-bc$, $-ac$, $-ab$ } residua sint ipsorum {a, b, c} [? see note] \begin{cases} a \times & b, c \\ b \times & c, a \\ c \times & a, b \end{cases} div. c. max.
a factt. suis quadratis liberati

Canon quantitatum imaginariarum exponentialium

$a^{\sqrt{-1}} = \cos. la + \sqrt{-1}. \sin la$
$(a+b\sqrt{-1})^{n\sqrt{-1}} = \left(\frac{a}{\cos\varphi}\right)^{n\sqrt{-1}} (\cos\varphi + \sin\varphi\sqrt{-1})^{n\sqrt{-1}}$
$\left(\frac{b}{a} = \tang\varphi\right) \quad = \left(\frac{a}{\cos\varphi}\right)^{n\sqrt{-1}} (\cos n(\sqrt{-1})\varphi + \sin \sqrt{-1}\varphi\sqrt{-1})$
$= \left(\frac{a}{\cos\varphi}\right)^{\sqrt{-1}} e^{-\varphi}$
$= e^{-n\,\mathrm{Arc.tg.}\frac{b}{a}} \left(\cos. n\, l\frac{aa+bb}{a} + \sin n\, l \frac{aa+bb}{a}\sqrt{-1}\right)$

$a + \frac{a}{aa+bb} + \left(e^{+\mathrm{Arc.tg.}\frac{b}{a}} + e^{-\mathrm{Arc.tg.}\frac{b}{a}}\right) \cos. l\frac{aa+bb}{a} = 1$
$b\left(-\frac{b}{aa+bb}\right) + \left(e^{-\mathrm{A.tg}\frac{b}{a}} [-+-] e^{+\mathrm{A.tg}\frac{b}{a}}\right) \sin l\frac{aa+bb}{a} = 0$

Hypoth. $aa + bb = 1$ \quad $N = \mathrm{Arc.cos.}\, a$
$2a + e^{N} + e^{-N} = 1$
